notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation. The revised one narrows the H1 holes to the M3 bolts' Ø2.6 pilots (the tap class); the opening is bonded to the tube and keeps its size. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
